questions.cardDe: Wie heißt Europas höchstgelegene Stadt: Davos, Klagenfurt oder Luzern?
questions.de: Welche Stadt im Kanton Graubünden gilt als Europas höchstgelegene Stadt?
questions.en: Which town in the canton of Grisons is regarded as Europe's highest-lying town?

timeline.labelEn: Davos first recorded by name, as 'Tavaus' (1213)

questions.notes: Davos (about 1,560 m) markets itself as the highest town in Europe; the claim depends on what counts as a town.

questions.cardDe: Die erste Ampel der Welt wurde 1901 in Berlin aufgestellt. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: In welcher Stadt wurde 1868 die erste Ampel der Welt aufgestellt?
questions.en: In which city was the world's first traffic light installed in 1868?

timeline.labelEn: World's first traffic light installed on Parliament Square in London
timeline.labelDe: Erste Ampel der Welt am Parliament Square in London aufgestellt

questions.notes: The card's statement (Berlin, 1901) is false; the first signal stood outside the Houses of Parliament in London from December 1868 and exploded in January 1869.

questions.de: Welcher französische Impressionist schuf Werke, die in der Mehrzahl vom Ballett handeln?
questions.en: Which French Impressionist created works most of which depict the ballet?

timeline.labelEn: Edgar Degas, French painter famed for his ballet dancers (1834–1917)
timeline.labelDe: Edgar Degas, französischer Maler, berühmt für seine Balletttänzerinnen (1834–1917)

questions.notes: The ballet is one of the few themes Degas varied again and again; he is usually counted among the Impressionists, with whom he exhibited.

questions.cardDe: Was sind keine Spinnentiere: Skorpione, Milben oder Läuse?
questions.de: Zu welcher Tierklasse gehören Läuse – anders als Skorpione und Milben, die Spinnentiere sind?
questions.en: To which class of animals do lice belong – unlike scorpions and mites, which are arachnids?

timeline.labelEn: Ernst Haeckel names the lice group Phthiraptera (1896)
timeline.labelDe: Ernst Haeckel benennt die Gruppe der Tierläuse als Phthiraptera (1896)

questions.notes: Tierläuse (Phthiraptera) are an insect order; the name Phthiraptera was coined by Ernst Haeckel in 1896 (en.wikipedia 'Louse').

timeline.labelEn: Tom Clancy, American thriller writer and co-founder of Red Storm Entertainment (1947–2013)
timeline.labelDe: Tom Clancy, US-amerikanischer Thrillerautor und Mitgründer von Red Storm Entertainment (1947–2013)
